title: Client
confirmDelete: Delete client "{name}"? Apps that sign in with it will no longer be able to sign in.
confirmBatchDelete: Delete the {count} selected clients? Apps that sign in with them will no longer be able to sign in.
clientKeyReadonly: The client ID is derived from the client key and secret, so neither can be changed after creation
activeTimeoutHelp: Sign-in expires after this much inactivity; -1 means no limit
timeoutHelp: Users must sign in again after this long; -1 means no limit
accessPathHelp: Only these paths can be accessed; ** wildcards are supported. Leave empty for no restriction
ipWhitelistHelp: Only these IPs can access. Single IPs, CIDR ranges (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8) and wildcards (e.g. 192.168.1.*) are supported. Leave empty for no restriction
